briefdescription.para: Return a pointer to the left subtree.

detaileddescription.para: This value is NULL if there is no left subtree.

briefdescription.para: Return a pointer to the right subtree.

detaileddescription.para: This value is NULL if there is no right subtree.

briefdescription.para: getHeight - Returns the height of the tree.

detaileddescription.para: A tree with no subtrees has a height of 1.

briefdescription.para: getValue - Returns the data value associated with the tree node.
find - Finds the subtree associated with the specified key value.

detaileddescription.para: This method returns NULL if no matching subtree is found.

briefdescription.para: getMaxElement - Find the subtree associated with the highest ranged key value.
size - Returns the number of nodes in the tree, which includes both leaves and non-leaf nodes.
begin - Returns an iterator that iterates over the nodes of the tree in an inorder traversal.

detaileddescription.para: The returned iterator thus refers to the the tree node with the minimum data element.

briefdescription.para: end - Returns an iterator for the tree that denotes the end of an inorder traversal.
isEqual - Compares two trees for structural equality and returns true if they are equal.

detaileddescription.para: This worst case performance of this operation is

briefdescription.para: isNotEqual - Compares two trees for structural inequality.

detaileddescription.para: Performance is the same is isEqual.

briefdescription.para: contains - Returns true if this tree contains a subtree (node) that has an data element that matches the specified key.

detaileddescription.para: Complexity is logarithmic in the size of the tree.

briefdescription.para: validateTree - A utility method that checks that the balancing and ordering invariants of the tree are satisfied.

detaileddescription.para: It is a recursive method that returns the height of the tree, which is then consumed by the enclosing validateTree call. External callers should ignore the return value. An invalid tree will cause an assertion to fire in a debug build.

memberdef.argsstring: (Factory *f, ImutAVLTree *l, ImutAVLTree *r, value_type_ref v, unsigned height)
memberdef.name: ImutAVLTree

briefdescription.para: ImutAVLTree - Internal constructor that is only called by ImutAVLFactory.
isMutable - Returns true if the left and right subtree references (as well as height) can be changed.

detaileddescription.para: If this method returns false, the tree is truly immutable. Trees returned from an ImutAVLFactory object should always have this method return true. Further, if this method returns false for an instance of ImutAVLTree, all subtrees will also have this method return false. The converse is not true.

briefdescription.para: hasCachedDigest - Returns true if the digest for this tree is cached.

detaileddescription.para: This can only be true if the tree is immutable.

briefdescription.para: markImmutable - Clears the mutable flag for a tree.

detaileddescription.para: After this happens, it is an error to call setLeft(), setRight(), and setHeight().

briefdescription.para: markedCachedDigest - Clears the NoCachedDigest flag for a tree.
setHeight - Changes the height of the tree.
